text: 韩国央行3年来首次加息！韩股走跌，估值隐忧与流动性压力陡升 韩国央行加入全球央行紧缩周期。韩国股市上半年录得历史级行情，但接下来估值隐忧与流动性压力陡升。
text_en: Bank of Korea raises rates for first time in three years! Korean stocks decline, valuation concerns and liquidity pressure surge as BOK joins global central bank tightening cycle; Korean stock market saw historic gains in first half but faces rising valuation and liquidity risks
